name: utility_appearance_colors
title: Utility Appearance Colors
summary: Turns post colors into --post-color-* CSS vars.
description: Turns a post's settings.appearance.colors (primary, secondary, canvas_primary, canvas_secondary) into --post-color-* CSS variables, with --dm-color-primary-* fallbacks. A color within 8% of black also gets --post-color-<name>-on-dark: var(--dm-color-gray-light), and one within 8% of white gets --post-color-<name>-on-light: var(--dm-color-gray-dark), so components can stay visible in both theme modes. Output as a style="" attribute, bare declarations, or a <style> tag.
